mentions.name: Leihbase
mentions.description: This is a self-hostable borrow store management system for running a library of things, currently used for one in the author's city. It includes a reservation system, a dashboard for managing reservations in the shop, and a product management interface is being added. Its goal is to help people abstain from buying items they only need once a year.
mentions.problem: Helps people abstain from buying things they only need once a year.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on a self-hostable borrow store management system: https://github.com/leihbase/leihbase.

I am running it in my city for a library of things. We hope to help  people abstain from buying things they only need once a year.

It includes a reservation system, and an dashboard to manage those reservations in the shop. Currently I'm expanding it with a proper product management interface.
